name: 4D Gaussian Rasterization
definition: Renders a scene represented by 4D Gaussians (3D spatial + 1D temporal) into a 2D image for a specific viewpoint and timestamp. It handles time-dependent opacity, position offsets, and spherical harmonics evaluation in 4D.
summary: 4D Gaussian Rasterization renders 4D Gaussians into 2D images for specific viewpoints and timestamps, supporting dynamic scenes through temporal attributes while maintaining differentiable rasterization.
